# Gauntlet Calibration

<!-- generated by arch.generators.gauntlet_calibration; do not hand-edit -->

The empirical calibration picture for the factory's evidence path — how much independent scrutiny merged changes actually carried, and how loudly the evidence path fails when a judge is unavailable. Shared instrument surface for the judge-independence budget + fail-visible dispatch (#10371) and the sampled-adversarial re-audit (#10370).

**This artifact is deterministic-from-source (instrument spec + schema).** Live values render on the dashboard panel (`/api/diagnostics/gauntlet-calibration`), which reads the append-only ledger at `<data_root>/diagnostics/fail_open_ledger.jsonl`.

## Metrics

| metric | definition |
|---|---|
| % classed merges with independent verdict | of changes in a blast-radius class (structural / security / migration / self-modification), the share whose post-verify verdict came from a model family OUTSIDE the implementing roster |
| fail-open rate | judge-unavailable → work-passed events per day; a Shewhart c-chart control limit (`cbar + 3*sqrt(cbar)`) flags spikes and `FailOpenMonitorLoop` files a `hydraflow-find` above-limit |
| independence-unavailable rate | classed changes that proceeded on a same-family verdict (or self-mod changes escalated to HITL) because no independent family was configured/reachable — degraded, never silent |
| disagreement-by-family | where an independent judge dissents from the sibling verdicts, partitioned by family — the empirical measure of how much correlated blindness the budget is catching |

## Fail-closed for self-modification

The self-modification class (changes touching the gauntlet, gates, detectors, merge policy, or this policy itself — including the classifier) is the highest class: a missing verdict on the machinery that produces verdicts is a STOP, not a degraded pass. A fail-open or a missing independent verdict on a self-mod change blocks the merge and escalates to HITL (feature-flagged: `HYDRAFLOW_JUDGE_SELF_MOD_FAIL_CLOSED`). All other classes remain fail-open but ledgered and alarmed.

## Sampled adversarial re-audit (#10370)

The silent-escape estimator: a governed random sample of merged PRs is re-reviewed by a FRESH adversarial context (the auditor sees only the merged diff + linked spec/issue + repo state — never the original verdicts). The disagreement rate is a statistical bound on the UNDETECTED escape rate — the complement to the escape ledger's *detected* count. Read-only (ADR-0029 Pattern B): post-merge only, never gates, reverts, or opens fix PRs.

| metric | definition |
|---|---|
| disagreement rate + 95% CI | share of audited samples the adversarial re-audit flagged `disagree`, with a Wilson-score interval — the headline statistical bound on silent escapes (a small-sample CI, since sampling is the point) |
| governed sample rate | the Shewhart-governed sampling fraction: widened toward a 20% ceiling above the disagreement control limit, narrowed toward a 2% floor when quiet (5% base), stratified by blast-radius class |
| auditor false-alarm rate | refuted disagreements / adjudicated disagreements — an auditor that over-fires gets its own alarm budget tightened |
| per-gate-class calibration | sampled / disagreement / upheld counts per blast-radius class (routine / structural / security / migration / gauntlet) — which gate the upheld escapes implicate |

**Ledger schema.** Append-only `<data_root>/diagnostics/audit_samples.jsonl` — one row per sampled merge (`verdict`, `findings`, an `input_sources` manifest proving no-verdict contamination, `disposition`). An UPHELD disagreement cross-links into the escape ledger (`detection_source: sampled-audit`); a REFUTED one increments the false-alarm series.
